summary: Today’s feed is broadly risk-off in macro assets, with traders focusing on hotter inflation prints, stronger dollar pressure, and volatility in metals and FX. In crypto, the tone is mixed-to-cautious: Bitcoin and major large caps remain relatively resilient, while several analysts are highlighting specific altcoin breakouts and a few short setups in overheated names.
